title: Device P99 hold duration at a fixed sampled 1000 ns threshold
author: Jonathan Yantis
primary_question: What is the longest experimentally supported sampled BLE-relative hold duration at empirical P99 of run-prefix maximum absolute error strictly below 1000 ns, and how does that frontier vary during each observation window?
estimand: For each offset frozen run and each programmed age, take maximum absolute error over its entire sampled prefix through the first actual BLE witness at or after that age. Compute nearest-rank empirical P99 across the latest up-to-128 run-prefix maxima and invert at strict <1000 ns on the consecutive age grid.
unknown_policy: Expiry without a confirming witness is unknown unless a prior sampled crossing already proves failure. Unknowns remain in the ring and count against passing; at least 100 non-unknown outcomes are required.

primary_observation.mode: continuous normal BLE operation, frozen production-policy shadows only
primary_observation.collection_end: Stop within the original finite capture lease, preserving all observed runs and partial endings.
primary_observation.start: Acquire before first START of verified fresh boot where possible; otherwise independently flush prehistory at each age.
primary_observation.selection: C-1 first; C-2 only on separate exact-device handoff. No failed or unavailable device is silently replaced.
primary_observation.intervention: No servo/model/source tuning, forced source outage, production HOLD selection or temperature intervention. Preserve normal AUTO and BLE operation.
primary_endpoints: longest consecutive qualifying age and first adequate failing frontier at fixed 1000 ns threshold
time evolution and paired live UI status throughout each complete declared capture
twelve-second result only as historical reference
primary_observation.predeclared_budget: C-1 initial one 600000 ms lease; C-2 two separate 600000 ms leases; C-1 one additional warm 600000 ms lease after C-2 release. Each stopped near 596 s before its unchanged original deadline; no early stop for good performance. Root explicitly approved expansion after initial C-1 capture; original data retained.
primary_observation.capture_boundaries: Fresh status, stop, normal-state/ownership verification, then fresh status/start for each separate lease. Administrative gaps explicitly separate populations; straddling prefixes are not numerically replayed as complete. Independent per-age flush restores a known 128-entry population.

gates: Exact installed source/build/boot/factory and exclusive ownership verified privately before opening
Original CRC/nonce response deadlines and finite capture lease retained
Numeric frozen-clock replay agrees with each complete firmware END within 1 ns
Age outcome bits agree exactly; statuses aligned to their own copied last20 snapshot
No two-second lane may establish a twelve-second population
No pooled per-witness quantile may be substituted for the run-prefix duration statistic
All crossing tails, unknowns, capture gaps and failures retained
Capture OFF, actual upstream AUTO, normal LoRa AUTO and page zero restored; USB closed and ownership released
secondary_evidence: Separately identified historical v30 horizon prefixes and selected-output 12/24/48-second tests; do not pool versions/conditions into the primary normal-operation ring.
interpretation: Empirical rolling sampled duration on correlated overlapping clocks in the declared observation window. Not a confidence-certified population reliability, continuous gap-interior, independent UTC, electrical output or oscillator temperature qualification.
reference_target_note: Twelve seconds was a historical reference suggestion, not the experiment objective or stopping rule.

secondary_finer_frontier.predeclared_at: During C2 first capture, before completion of either added warm capture and before any 100-mature-run long cohort was available. Adopted in response to the operator's explicit longest-duration goal; no outcome-selected window.
secondary_finer_frontier.cohort: Separately per device/segment, final up-to-128 STARTs with probe>=96s whose original probe+1s deadline elapsed before capture end; no outcome selection.
secondary_finer_frontier.maturity_clock: last recorded accepted-pair availability in the continuous segment
secondary_finer_frontier.immature_policy: Report all immature/right-censored long STARTs separately; no manufactured endpoints. Expired/aborted mature STARTs remain in selected cohort with fail/unknown as appropriate.
secondary_finer_frontier.scoring: Same first actual witness at/after age and entire prefix maximum; stop at actual END, no interpolation or future post-END witness. Ages beyond original programmed probe remain censored.
secondary_finer_frontier.decision: At least100scored; unknowns count against pass, nearest-rank threshold identical. Report last consecutive passing one-second age and first adequately populated failing age.
secondary_finer_frontier.scope: Offline recomputed fixed mature long-run cohort, separate from mixed-lane 26-age rolling device/OLED result; not changed firmware or UI.

conditional_frontier_amendment.decision_time: Approved and recorded before completion of C1 warm lease, while its independently reconstructed96s population still contained failures.
conditional_frontier_amendment.condition: Only after the current warm600s lease completes and releases normally: independently reproduced consecutive device H99>=96s, all required age populations known/min100scored, and120s scored<100.
conditional_frontier_amendment.action: One additional distinct600000ms C1 lease on same exact verifiedv33 boot/source, fresh validation and unchanged original per-lease deadlines.
conditional_frontier_amendment.purpose: Populate120s next frontier under longest-duration objective; no source/controller/temperature tuning.
conditional_frontier_amendment.stopping: Fixed budget regardless outcome; if120s qualifies report>=120s test cap, not physical maximum; ifconditionfalse open nohardware.
conditional_frontier_amendment.selection: Conditioned follow-up cohort kept separate; all earlier failures/unknowns/windows retained, no independent-trial confidence claim.
